I've folded all thirteen additions into the specification. Here's what changed and what to review.

## 📋 Updated Specification: Bookmark Manager (v2)

`specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md` — now 13 prioritized user stories with acceptance examples for each.

### What I added from your feedback

| # | Behavior | Key acceptance detail |
|---|----------|----------------------|
| **Metadata** (US1/FR-003–005) | Capture title, description, favicon, preview image; edit title & description | Missing metadata degrades gracefully; URL as fallback label |
| **Open + note** (US2/FR-006–007) | Personal note per bookmark; selecting opens original in new tab | Note persists across reloads |
| **Edit-on-duplicate** (US3/FR-008) | Re-saving a known URL **opens the existing bookmark to edit** | No duplicate created |
| **Advanced search** (US4/FR-009–012) | Case-insensitive across title/URL/description/note/tags; `#tag`, `"phrases"`, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, parentheses | Malformed queries reported clearly |
| **Tag suggestions** (US5/FR-013–014) | Suggest existing tags while typing | Avoids duplicate tag variants |
| **Read-later** (US6/FR-015) | Unread state + separate unread view + mark read | Unread view excludes archived |
| **Archiving** (US7/FR-016) | Reversible; excluded from normal list/search; own view | Restorable |
| **Bulk actions** (US8/FR-017) | Multi-select or "all in current results"; tag/read/archive/delete | Single confirm for batch delete |
| **Sorting** (US9/FR-018) | Newest, oldest, title, last-updated | Respects default preference |
| **Saved filters** (US10/FR-019) | Named, from terms + included/excluded tags | Create/apply/delete |
| **Import/export** (US11/FR-020) | Standard browser bookmark HTML; titles, tags, dates preserved | Merges, doesn't duplicate |
| **Page copies** (US12/FR-021–022) | Local copy (PDFs as PDFs) + Internet Archive option | Failures reported, bookmark intact |
| **Display prefs** (US13/FR-024) | Default sort, items per view, text size | Persisted |

I also added round-trip and link-rot success criteria (SC-006, SC-007) and recorded the external dependency on the Internet Archive service in Assumptions.

### Two points worth an explicit decision

1. **Internet Archive** is an external public service. If it's unreachable during a review or in general, that step will simply report a failure (the bookmark is unaffected). Fine as specified?
2. **Local page copy** preserves page *content* (an offline-readable copy). Fully pixel-perfect, script-driven interactive pages may not reproduce exactly — the spec commits to preserving readable content and PDFs as PDFs. Acceptable?

---

Please review the updated spec. Once you approve it, I'll move to the **plan** gate (`speckit-plan`). If any of the 13 areas still isn't captured the way you meant, tell me and I'll revise the spec before we plan — nothing gets built until spec and plan are approved.
